answer: Randomness-gated identity slots work as a bridge: each period a verifiable beacon assigns applicants to a limited pool of registration slots whose timing the attacker cannot predict in advance. A velvet rule denies any wallet that misses its assigned window, forcing Sybil farms to keep every identity live across cycles. Missed slots push contenders to a tundra of unassigned capacity, so each retained identity costs continuous monitoring and repeated fees.
